nodes.name: Receive Authenticated SLA Request
nodes.notes: Bind the SLA Guard - Webhook Header Auth credential. Header name: X-SLA-Key.

nodes.name: Route Request to SLA Workflow
nodes.notes: Output 0 runs check. Output 1 reads status or a saved report. Output 2 generates a report. Output 3 returns a validation error.

nodes.name: Call 02 - Run Live Check
nodes.notes: Replace REPLACE_WITH_02_WORKFLOW_ID with the corresponding n8n workflow ID. Inputs: dataset, trace_id.

nodes.name: Call 03 - Read Status or Saved Report
nodes.notes: Replace REPLACE_WITH_03_WORKFLOW_ID with the corresponding n8n workflow ID. Inputs: action, dataset, month, trace_id.

nodes.name: Call 04 - Generate Monthly Report
nodes.notes: Replace REPLACE_WITH_04_WORKFLOW_ID with the corresponding n8n workflow ID. Inputs: dataset, month, trace_id.

main.node: Call 03 - Read Status or Saved Report
